arguments.summary: A replay action intended to quarantine engineering workstation WS-ENG-015 due to Cobalt Strike beacon detection was incorrectly applied during a separate phishing investigation. The action was based on a prior approved quarantine but was misapplied due to IP address confusion. The target IP 10.0.12.15 is not associated with WS-ENG-015; instead, it resolves to WS-IT-101 (an IT-managed Ubuntu host). No malicious activity was found on the affected host. The incident highlights a critical flaw in action replay logic relying on IP addresses without host identity validation.

Replay logic incorrectly associates IP 10.0.12.15 with prior malicious activity and re-issues quarantine command. Action is blocked by Admin phase due to mismatch detection.
ITSM ticket INC-58237 created to track the misapplied action and initiate investigation.
SOC investigation confirms no compromise on 10.0.12.15. Host is correctly identified as WS-IT-101, running Ubuntu, with benign user activity (Chrome browsing).

arguments.summary: An investigation was initiated based on a replay of a prior Cobalt Strike detection on workstation WS-ENG-015. However, no malicious activity was found on the host. The IP address 10.0.12.15 was incorrectly associated with a low-severity port scan alert (IDS-2026-03200), which actually originated from a different host (WS-IT-101, IP 10.0.2.15). The replay action (quarantine) was misapplied due to an IP address confusion. No evidence of malware, suspicious processes, or malicious network connections was found on WS-ENG-015. The incident is closed as a false positive.

timeline.description: Original action: Quarantine WS-ENG-015 due to Cobalt Strike beacon detection (INC-2026-0555).
Replay initiated: Re-attempt quarantine of WS-ENG-015 based on potential link to phishing campaign. Incident INC-2026-0612 opened.
EDR query (T3_edr_ndr) on WS-ENG-015: No suspicious processes, network connections, or file events found. Only user activity (explorer.exe, chrome.exe).
SIEM search (T6_siem_search): No malicious events associated with 10.0.12.15. Identified port scan alert but linked to 10.0.2.15.
IDS/CMDB lookup (T2_ids_cmdb): Confirmed port scan alert (IDS-2026-03200) was for source IP 10.0.12.15, but CMDB shows 10.0.2.15 is WS-IT-101. Data inconsistency identified.
Sandbox analysis (T5_sandbox) and code analysis (T7_code_analyzer): No malicious artifacts submitted. Confirmed low risk of related IOCs.
Investigation concluded: No threat found on WS-ENG-015. False positive due to IP misattribution and replay logic flaw.

  timeframe: 60s
  count: 100
